content.title: Raven-Symoné reveals her Disney Channel Mount Rushmore
content.text: Raven-Symoné deserves to be in the Disney Channel Hall of Fame, but the people she’d include with her may surprise you.Raven-Symone arrives at the world premiere of "The Lion King" on Tuesday, July 9, 2019, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. (Photo by Jordan Strauss/Invision/AP)Raven skyrocketed to fame as Denise Huxtable’s precocious stepdaughter, Olivia, on “The Cosby Show.” From there, she went on to star in Disney Channel’s “Zenon: Girl of the 21st Century,” one of the first Disney Channel Original Movies (DCOMs), and “Kim Possible” before getting the lead in her own TV show, “That’s So Raven,” and starring in “The Cheetah Girls.” Basically, she’s a Disney Channel legend.When it comes to the faces Raven would carve into a Disney Channel mountain next to her own, she told “The Shade Room” podcast, “I would say me, Hilary [Duff], Shia [LaBeouf]. I would also put in ‘The Famous Jett Jackson,’” a character played by Lee Thompson Young.This undated publicity image released by TNT shows actor Lee Thompson Young in a scene from the TNT series, "Rizzoli & Isles." Los Angeles. (AP Photo/TNT, Doug Hyan)When asked about Miley Cyrus, Raven said, “No, not Miley” before quickly adding, “I love you, Miley, but not Miley. She came after.”LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA - FEBRUARY 20: Hilary Duff attends her "luck...or something" Album Celebration Event at The Grove on February 20, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Emma McIntyre/Getty Images for ABA)As for why Raven would include the “Johnny Tsunami” actor, who passed away at age 29 in 2013, she said, “He was the first Black show on Disney I believe he should be on Disney Rushmore. He definitely deserves a spot.”As talk of data centers persists, Northeast Wisconsin officials attend forum to learn moreFILE - In this Nov. 3, 2019, file photo, Shia LaBeouf arrives at the 23rd annual Hollywood Film Awards at the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Beverly Hills, Calif. LaBeouf has been charged on Sept. 24, 2020, with misdemeanor battery and petty theft. Prosecutors allege that the 34-year-old actor fought with a man named Tyler Murphy and took his hat on June 12, according to a criminal complaint obtained by The Associated Press on Thursday, Oct. 1, from the Los Angeles city attorney. (Photo by Richard Shotwell/Invision/AP, File)The members of Raven’s Disney Channel Mount Rushmore all have a few things in common, including that they were all on Disney Channel in the early days of the network. Thompson Young’s “The Famous Jett Jackson” was only the second live-action Disney Channel original comedy, LaBeouf’s “Even Stevens” was the fourth, Hilary Duff’s “Lizzie McGuire” was the fifth, and “That’s So Raven” was the sixth and the only one on this list not to get a spin-off film.BURBANK, CALIFORNIA: In this image released on December 20, 2025, Raven-Symoné attends the 28th Family Film and TV Awards at Associated Television Int'l Studios in Burbank, California. (Photo by Phillip Faraone/Getty Images for Family Film and TV Awards)All four actors also starred in various DCOMs, such as “Johnny Tsunami,” “Tru Confessions,” “Cadet Kelly,” and “The Cheetah Girls.”Follow us on Instagram @WeArePauseRewind for all your pop culture obsessions.
